0.why: Harmoblender.cpp Harmoblender::process: setChannels then setVoltage(lvl_Multiplier * the sum of sixteen table reads, idx); each read is scaled to ±5V and multiplied by a level of up to 1, so the sum is not bounded by ±5V, commit 55aa542, the 2.4.1 release commit, whose plugin.json carries the installed 2.4.1 and whose res/ matches the installed panels

comment: The level jacks replace the knob while patched; the phase jacks add to it after an abs(). A Mult of 0 makes STS_My_Sine index the table at the phase shift alone, which is a constant, not silence; the manual says a Mult of 0 does not add to the signal. In the branch taken with V/Oct patched the Pitch In modulation is pitch_param * V * 0.1 rather than freq * V * 0.1, so it is a fixed hertz offset independent of the note; the manual describes the jack as one octave up and down, which matches neither branch. The level inputs are configured with the name "Harmonic n Level CV (0..10V)" while the code reads them over ±10V. There is no clipping on the output.
